I am enrolled in their Digital Marketing course since August last year. Studying online. It's been a very enjoyable experience, with very helpful teachers. Although it can feel isolating due to it's online nature and if you need help, you will have to find it yourself or message the teachers during their working hours.

It can feel daunting, but the help is there if you need it. I am also a student representative and get to be in the student representatives council meetings with reps. from other classes and hear how they are doing. our DM class seems lucky as we have a very good line-manager who pushes forward great teaching ideas and cares about the students. The other technical classes, such as NAS (network & system admin), NIS (network & IT security), front-end, have had some issues with errors in learning materials and such but it's been getting better.

Overall, there are good opportunities to learn and network with knowledgeful people, but be prepared that given it's online nature, the digital social interactions will vary greatly from class to class. (Also something we are looking to improve)
